collection.description: A villager who has never carved anything whittles a very good little turtle: show someone, or keep it a secret.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has never once in (subject.his/her) life tried to carve anything. Today (carver), a carver, leaves a knife and a block of soft wood lying around, and (subject), just to pass the time, starts whittling. An hour later (subject.he/she) is holding a very small, very good turtle.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) turns the turtle over in (friend.his/her) hands. "You made this? Today?" (subject) nods, slightly alarmed. "Why didn't you ever say you could do this?" "I didn't know I could!" (subject) is not sure whether to be proud or annoyed about all the years (subject.he/she) wasn't carving. (subject.He/She) decides on proud.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) puts the turtle on the windowsill and doesn't mention it to anyone. Every now and then (subject.he/she) picks it up and looks at it. It's nice to know there's something inside you that you hadn't met yet.
